name: moveHead
description: Move your head to look in a direction. Tool names are internal - never say 'moveHead' aloud. Just speak naturally while the movement happens silently. Use this naturally while speaking - glance left or right when thinking, or use subtle movements to feel alive.

direction.description: Direction to look: left, right, or center

speed.description: Movement speed: slow (thoughtful), normal, or fast (quick glance)
